whyUs.heading: 飛行，不該有門檻。
whyUs.bodyHtml:
中華虛擬航空是一個讓熱愛飛行的人聚在一起的地方。 從第一次起飛的緊張，到熟練巡航的從容， 我們陪你走過每一段航程。
這裡沒有壓力，只有分享與成長；
沒有距離，只有共同仰望的天空。

items.question: 什麼是虛擬航空？
items.answerHtml: 虛擬航空是一個模擬真實航空公司的團體，透過連飛平台，成員們可以在虛擬天空中飛行，並且可以與其他飛行員與航管進行溝通。

items.question: 會不會被開除？
items.answerHtml: 原則上不會，除非違反本虛擬航空規定。

items.question: 加入後具體來說要做什麼？
items.answerHtml: 在虛擬天空中翱翔，並遵守當地飛行規定

items.question: 有薪水嗎？
items.answerHtml: 當然不會有薪水拉😂，但會不定時發送禮物，年末會舉辦抽獎活動慰勞各位

items.question: 我飛不好會不會被罵？
items.answerHtml: 不會<del>，但可能會被笑</del>，我們是一個友善的社群，歡迎任何人加入，不論您是新手或老手，我們都會以最大的熱情歡迎您的加入。

privacy.heading: 隱私權政策
privacy.intro: 我們將基於虛擬航空公司對飛行員的角度蒐集以下資料:
items: 您的暱稱, 您的英文名縮寫, IVAO VID, VATSIM CID
您飛行的相關紀錄，僅限於當時飛行的呼號及飛行數據
paragraphs: 我們將保留這些資料並顯示於我們網站上並作為活動宣傳使用。

meta.title: China Airlines Virtual
meta.description: China Airlines Virtual was established in Taiwan on September 3, 2021. It is a non-profit virtual airlines, where we can enjoy stress-free flights in the virtual skies together with fellow enthusiasts.

items.question: What is virtual airlines?
items.answerHtml: Virtual airlines is a virtual network that simulates real-world airlines, where pilots can fly in the virtual skies and communicate with other pilots and air traffic control.

items.question: Will I be fired?
items.answerHtml: No, unless you violate the rules of this virtual airline.

items.question: What exactly do I need to do after joining?
items.answerHtml: Soar in the virtual skies and follow the local flight regulations.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We collect personal data strictly related to your role as a pilot within our organization:
items: Your nickname, IVAO VID, VATSIM CID
Flight logs and records, limited to callsigns and specific flight telemetry/data generated during your flights.
paragraphs: The collected data will be retained and displayed on our official website. This information is used for operational tracking and promotional purposes (such as event highlights and community showcases).
Your GDPR Rights: You can request to access, correct, or delete your data, and withdraw your consent at any time.
